dialogues.speaker: Scheffield
dialogues.text: Ugh, my head hurts... What the devil's with this... Fire-Water...

dialogues.speaker: Scheffield
dialogues.text: I... I've had too much Fire-Water... Ugh, I thought that a bit of alcohol in the system might help me pen some good verses...

dialogues.speaker: Scheffield
dialogues.text: Isn't that how bards are supposed to be, falling further into a frenzied artistic trance the more they drink, thus producing their best work?

dialogues.speaker: Scheffield
dialogues.text: But, uh... Fire-Water's a bit too much of a step up from, say, beer... All I feel right now is pain...

dialogues.speaker: Scheffield
dialogues.text: Oh, I'll be fine... I was just... chugging it down, you know?

dialogues.speaker: Scheffield
dialogues.text: Trust me, I'm a Mondstadter... I'm sure our blood will tell soon enough... just need some time to get used to this Fire-Water.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I think you need to drink a bit less of it.

dialogues.speaker: Scheffield
dialogues.text: Perhaps... *sigh* But I mean, I'm in Snezhnaya, Barbatos' sake! What would a trip here be without the taste of Fire-Water?
